test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

Ram could not go to Delhi for vacation since he __was banking on__ his arrears of pay which he did not get in time
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. **'Relying on'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase in focus is **"banking on",** which correctly means **"relying on".**
 
• Relying on (निर्भर करना) - To depend on someone or something for help or support.
 
 
• **Example:** She was relying on her savings to pay for her studies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Relying on'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sloping on (ढलान पर होना) - This is not a relevant idiomatic expression in this context. Its literal interpretation would involve a physical incline, which does not fit.
 
• Depending on his bank (अपने बैंक पर निर्भर होना) - This refers to relying on a financial institution, but it is too literal and not what is meant here.
 
• Calling on (बुलाना या अपील करना) - This means to visit someone or to appeal to someone or something, which doesn't correctly interpret the phrase "banking on".

57:T8b4,

The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'usually'.**
